name: monimal
description: Monorepo spike: maximal, maximal-core and maximal-electron in one pnpm workspace, driven by Turborepo.

scripts.check:static: turbo run build typecheck lint && pnpm run check:network-literals && pnpm run check:unsafe-type-assertions && pnpm run check:settings
scripts.check:settings: pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-settings run migration:check && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-settings run security:check
scripts.test:maximal-configurators:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-configurators test && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-core run test:configurator-harness
scripts.test:connections:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-configurators test && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-core test && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-client test && pnpm --filter maximal-desktop test
scripts.test:settings:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-settings test && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-client test && pnpm --filter maximal-desktop test
scripts.mutate:core:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-core exec stryker run
scripts.check:core: pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-core run check:deep:host && pnpm run test:core
scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run check:cross-package-duplicates && pnpm --filter @maximal/maximal-core run check:deep:host && pnpm test
